title: gentianella kuntzei
intro: Gentianella kuntzei, commonly known as Alpine gentian, is a species of flowering plant in the family Gentianaceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to support digestive health and alleviate symptoms of indigestion and bloating, thanks to its health benefits of soothing the stomach and regulating appetite. The therapeutic actions of Gentianella kuntzei include anti-inflammatory and carminative properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and ease digestive discomfort. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
